_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-68 directional base rate in this coil is the single most powerful signal in the dataset — HOLD with conviction is the statistically honest call until ETF flows revive or MVRV compresses below 15 to break the coil.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing contradictory internals; narrative implies directional upside via mean reversion but does not commit to a phase or signal
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows >20 with funding <45 and btc_momentum_30d >55 — confirms transition to Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows stays 0-10 with vix >65 and funding >55 — pushes down to Anxiety
